introduction: Mississippi weatherization helps qualifying households improve home-energy efficiency. MDHS works with local service providers.
description: Mississippi weatherization helps qualifying households improve home-energy efficiency. MDHS works with local service providers.

sections.who: The state lists an income limit tied to current federal poverty guidelines. Ask the provider about household priority and property conditions.
sections.get: An assessment identifies eligible energy-saving work; the program is not general home renovation.
sections.docs:
• Household income and residency evidence.
  • Energy bills.
  • Property or landlord records requested locally.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Visit MDHS weatherization and follow the current application route.

  2. Contact the provider

    Confirm required documents, renter permissions and availability.

  3. Arrange assessment

    The provider checks the home before determining work.
sections.after: Ask about waiting times and repairs outside the program’s scope.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Mississippi WAP guidance. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does it pay an ordinary utility bill?
Its main purpose is improving efficiency.
Are income rules fixed dollar amounts?
They change with the applicable guidelines.
Can I arrange work before approval?
Ask the provider before making commitments.
